mkm.text: Vitu-Ghazi, the great oak of the Selesnya Conclave, is where Kaya goes to consult the Guildpact, and Trostani appears from it as three dryads and agrees to let her.
Kaya reads there that the founders bound the demon Rakdos to a people of his own to contain his murderous influence, and she connects Etrata's missing memory to that influence.

Proft later explains that the roots of Vitu-Ghazi spread throughout the city and could deliver the killer's flowers anywhere, so the killer must be a member of the Selesnya, and he names Trostani as the mastermind.

Oba breaks her calm and admits she killed the guild leaders because they deserved it, separating from her sisters to end Trostani as a unified being and drawing on the Ravnican Worldsoul itself, until Kaya addresses the Worldsoul directly and argues that a Ravnica that takes sides is no Ravnica.
